items.title: 68642_Jo Jones oral history interview
items.q: After December of '41 the war come along but Don Byas was there with the band.

ctx.x: After December of '41 the war come along but Don Byas was there with the band. When we went to the Lincoln Hotel something happened with Don Byas and Basie told me to go find Lester. Lester by that time had left the USO Show and he was playing on 52nd Street. I went round to the White Rose and got Lester and Lester didn't know what I was doing. I bought him a glass of beer. Lester didn't know how to drink no anything about beer; Lester didn't drink at that time.
